_comment: Tracks are a centreline plus a width; everything else - road, barriers,
checkpoints, the start grid, jumps and surface changes - is derived from it
at load time. A new stage is a few dozen numbers, not a hand-built scene.
'theme' picks which scenery props are scattered beside the road (see
data/props.json); it defaults to the surface. 'props' places hazards on the
racing surface itself, where 'side' is across the road as a fraction of half
width, so -1 is the left edge and 0 the centre line, and 'along' is metres
past the waypoint. Those are real bodies you can hit, so place them where a

tracks.name: Pine Ridge Loop
tracks.description: The club loop. Wide, forgiving, and a good place to learn what a car does.

tracks.name: Blackwood Sprint
tracks.description: Narrow, fast, and lined with trees. Run after dark, so all you have is what the headlights reach.

tracks.name: Harbour Circuit
tracks.description: Sealed surface, walls close in. Grip is high until it very suddenly is not.

tracks.name: Kaltavaara Stage
tracks.description: Long, mixed-surface and relentless. Tarmac hairpins into loose gravel.

tracks.name: Frostfell Trial
tracks.description: Packed snow with ice in the shade. Studded tires or an early bath.

tracks.name: Scrapyard Bowl
tracks.description: An arena, not a course. No finish line, just the last car moving.

tracks.name: Ahonpaa Village Sprint
tracks.description: Two kilometres of village tarmac between stone walls. Narrow, fast and completely unforgiving of a wide line.

tracks.name: Granite Quarry Run
tracks.description: Loose gravel across a working quarry, with two crests that will have you off the ground whether you meant it or not.

tracks.name: Saltmarsh Coast
tracks.description: Long, open sea-wall tarmac. The corners are quick rather than tight, so it rewards a car that stays settled at speed.

tracks.name: Lakeside Night Stage
tracks.description: Dirt along the lake shore after dark. Your headlights are the only thing between you and the water.

tracks.name: Hjelmstad Pass
tracks.description: A mountain pass that starts and ends on tarmac and loses its surface in the middle. One stage, two very different cars needed.

tracks.name: Arctic Marathon
tracks.description: The longest stage in the game, on snow the whole way. Nothing about it is difficult; all of it is difficult for long enough.

tracks.name: Harbour Night Sprint
tracks.description: Dock roads after dark. Nine hundred metres, stone on both sides, and nowhere at all to put a mistake.

tracks.name: Birch Valley
tracks.description: Gravel sweepers that never quite straighten out. Lift once and you have lost the whole sequence.

tracks.name: Old Quarry Descent
tracks.description: Five switchbacks cut into working stone. First gear, full lock, and a drop on the outside of every one.

tracks.name: Fjord Road
tracks.description: Four kilometres of coast road. Long enough that fuel and tyres start to matter, and fast enough that they matter a lot.

tracks.name: Deep Forest Marathon
tracks.description: Six kilometres of narrow dirt in the dark. Nothing about it is fast, and every one of those kilometres is a chance to get it wrong.

tracks.name: Frozen Lake Circuit
tracks.description: A course marked out in snow banks on lake ice. Nothing here is a wall, and nothing here grips either.

tracks.name: Kivelä Car Park
tracks.description: A supermarket car park after closing, taped off with cones. Nine hundred metres of second gear and no room to make a mistake worth telling anyone about.

tracks.name: Lehmusrinne Estate Run
tracks.description: Four blocks of housing, a lookout on every junction and no permission from anybody. Home before the second call comes in.

tracks.name: Ojala Farmyard Dash
tracks.description: Somebody's yard, somebody's field, and a line of hay bales where the barn used to have a door. Everyone watching knows whose tractor is in the way.

tracks.name: Riverside Meadow
tracks.description: A club course cut into a water meadow with a mower and a bag of pegs. Wide, soft, and impossible to hurt yourself on.

tracks.name: Kartano Club Circuit
tracks.description: A real circuit at last: kerbs, run-off, a timing tower and somebody in the pit lane who knows what your class is.

tracks.name: Norsholm Motorpark
tracks.description: Two kilometres of proper motorpark, run anticlockwise, with three places to pass and a chicane that has ended more races than the rest of it together.

tracks.name: Kanervikko Airfield
tracks.description: A closed airfield with a course taped out across the apron. Twenty metres of concrete either side of the tape, so the only thing a mistake costs is time.

tracks.name: Hiekkaranta Dunes
tracks.description: Sand blown over a track cut between the dunes. The surface moves under you, the marram grass hides the edges, and the sea is close enough to hear.

tracks.name: Granite Pit Floor
tracks.description: The floor of a working quarry on a Sunday. Crushed stone in every direction, walls three storeys high, and the whole thing echoes.

tracks.name: Hjelmstad Meadow
tracks.description: A cattle pasture above the tree line with a course mown into it. Grass on all sides, a drop you can see from everywhere, and no fence anywhere.

tracks.name: Routapelto Ice Field
tracks.description: A ploughed course on a frozen field, run under floodlights on poles somebody drove in that morning. Nothing to hit for two hundred metres, and no grip at all.

tracks.name: Saha Timber Yard
tracks.description: Between the log stacks at a sawmill, on ground packed hard by forty years of loaders. Smells of resin and diesel, and the sawdust is slippery when it rains.
